text: Hi, I saw the ad for the apartment in Zapopan. Is it still available?
Hi! Yes, it's still available. So I can show you what fits you best: are you looking to live there or to invest?
To live in. I'd pay with an Infonavit loan.
Great. Would you like to see it? I can book you a showing with an agent on Saturday at 11:00 AM or Sunday at 12:30 PM.
Saturday. How much would they lend me?
That depends on your loan, and the agent will go over it with you at the showing; I can't give you an amount. I'll book you with him on Saturday at 11:00 AM. What name should I put it under?
All set, Jorge: showing on Saturday at 11:00 AM. I'll send you the location and a reminder.
